name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 4 visits over 29 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 29 hours starting 2026-02-07, at wavelengths from 1.40 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
